title: 居家活動
description: 在家中進行的各種活動

sentences.en: On rainy days when I have nowhere to be, I love curling up on the couch with a good book and a warm cup of tea.
sentences.zh: 在下雨天而且沒有地方要去的時候，我喜歡蜷縮在沙發上看一本好書配一杯熱茶。

sentences.en: I've been trying to organize my closet for weeks now, but every time I start, I get distracted by old photos and memories that I find tucked away inside.
sentences.zh: 我已經試著整理衣櫃好幾週了，但每次開始，我都會被藏在裡面發現的舊照片和回憶分心。

sentences.en: Since I started working from home, I've had to set up a proper workspace in the corner of my living room to separate work from relaxation.
sentences.zh: 自從我開始在家工作，我必須在客廳的角落設置一個正式的工作空間，把工作和休息分開。

sentences.en: The kitchen, which used to be the room I spent the least time in, has now become my favorite place to experiment with new recipes on weekends.
sentences.zh: 廚房以前是我待最少時間的房間，現在已經變成我週末最喜歡嘗試新食譜的地方。

sentences.en: What I enjoy most about gardening on my small balcony is watching the plants I've grown from seeds slowly bloom into something beautiful.
sentences.zh: 我最喜歡在小陽台上園藝的是看著我從種子開始種的植物慢慢開出美麗的花朵。

sentences.en: After spending the entire day cleaning and reorganizing the apartment, I felt a deep sense of satisfaction looking at how neat everything had become.
sentences.zh: 花了一整天打掃和重新整理公寓後，看著一切變得多麼整齊，我感到深深的滿足感。

sentences.en: My weekend baking project, which started as a simple attempt to make bread, has now evolved into a full-blown obsession with pastry techniques.
sentences.zh: 我週末的烘焙計畫最初只是簡單嘗試做麵包，現在已經演變成對糕點技巧的完全著迷。

sentences.en: I find that doing household chores while listening to music or a podcast makes the whole process significantly more enjoyable and less tedious.
sentences.zh: 我發現做家事時聽音樂或播客讓整個過程明顯更愉快、不那麼無聊。

sentences.en: Having recently adopted a cat from the local shelter, I've had to rearrange quite a few things around the house to make it safe and comfortable for her.
sentences.zh: 最近從當地收容所領養了一隻貓後，我不得不重新安排家裡很多東西，讓它對她來說既安全又舒適。

sentences.en: On Sunday mornings, my partner and I take turns making an elaborate breakfast, which has become one of our most cherished weekend rituals.
sentences.zh: 星期天早上，我和伴侶輪流做一頓豐盛的早餐，這已經成為我們最珍惜的週末儀式之一。

sentences.en: The reason I prefer staying in on Friday nights is that after a long week of socializing at work, I genuinely crave some peace and quiet.
sentences.zh: 我喜歡星期五晚上待在家的原因是，經過一整週在工作中社交後，我真心渴望一些安靜和平靜。

sentences.en: I've recently gotten into the habit of doing a fifteen-minute yoga session in my living room every morning before I start my workday.
sentences.zh: 我最近養成了每天早上在客廳做十五分鐘瑜珈的習慣，然後才開始一天的工作。

sentences.en: Whenever I feel stressed or overwhelmed, I find that spending an hour or two cooking a complicated meal helps me clear my mind and refocus.
sentences.zh: 每當我感到壓力大或不堪重負時，我發現花一兩個小時做一道複雜的料理能幫助我清理思緒、重新集中注意力。

sentences.en: The home renovation project that we started last spring ended up taking much longer than expected, but the results were absolutely worth the wait.
sentences.zh: 我們去年春天開始的房屋翻新工程最後花的時間比預期長很多，但結果絕對值得等待。

sentences.en: I try to keep my phone in another room while I'm relaxing at home, because otherwise I end up mindlessly scrolling for hours without realizing it.
sentences.zh: 我在家放鬆時盡量把手機放在另一個房間，因為否則我會不自覺地漫無目的滑手機好幾個小時。

sentences.en: One of the best investments I've made for my home was buying a quality set of kitchen knives, which has completely transformed my cooking experience.
sentences.zh: 我為家裡做的最好的投資之一是買了一套好的廚房刀具，這完全改變了我的烹飪體驗。

sentences.en: Since the weather has been too hot to go outside, I've been spending my afternoons working on a jigsaw puzzle that has over a thousand pieces.
sentences.zh: 因為天氣熱到不能出門，我下午一直在拼一幅超過一千片的拼圖。

sentences.en: My neighbor recommended a great online tutorial for fixing minor plumbing issues, which ended up saving me a lot of money on calling a professional.
sentences.zh: 我的鄰居推薦了一個很棒的線上教學影片來修理小型水管問題，結果幫我省了很多請專業人員的錢。

sentences.en: There's something incredibly therapeutic about spending an entire afternoon decluttering your space and donating things you no longer need to charity.
sentences.zh: 花一整個下午清理空間並把不再需要的東西捐給慈善機構，有一種難以置信的療癒感。

sentences.en: I've set up a small reading nook in the corner of my bedroom with a comfortable armchair and a lamp, which has become my favorite spot in the house.
sentences.zh: 我在臥室角落設了一個小閱讀角，有一張舒適的扶手椅和一盞燈，那裡已經成為我家中最喜歡的地方。

sentences.en: Although my apartment is quite small, I've managed to make the most of the limited space by using creative storage solutions I found online.
sentences.zh: 雖然我的公寓很小，但我透過在網路上找到的創意收納方案，成功地充分利用了有限的空間。

sentences.en: Every evening after dinner, my family gathers in the living room to watch a movie or play board games together, which I think is great for bonding.
sentences.zh: 每天晚餐後，我的家人聚在客廳一起看電影或玩桌遊，我認為這對增進感情非常好。

sentences.en: The indoor herb garden that I planted on my kitchen windowsill last month has been growing surprisingly well, especially the basil and mint.
sentences.zh: 上個月我在廚房窗台上種的室內香草園長得出奇地好，特別是羅勒和薄荷。

sentences.en: I've discovered that the key to maintaining a tidy home is to put things back where they belong immediately rather than letting them pile up over time.
sentences.zh: 我發現保持家裡整潔的關鍵是立刻把東西放回原位，而不是讓它們隨時間堆積。

sentences.en: On cold winter nights, there's nothing quite as comforting as wrapping yourself in a thick blanket and watching the rain fall outside your window.
sentences.zh: 在寒冷的冬夜裡，沒有什麼比裹著厚毯子看著窗外的雨落下更讓人感到溫暖舒適的了。

sentences.en: I spent the whole Saturday afternoon rearranging the furniture in my bedroom, trying to find a layout that would make the room feel more spacious.
sentences.zh: 我花了整個星期六下午重新擺放臥室的家具，試著找到一個能讓房間感覺更寬敞的配置。

sentences.en: Having finally learned how to fix basic things around the house, I feel much more confident about handling minor repairs without needing to call anyone.
sentences.zh: 終於學會了如何修理家裡的基本東西後，我對處理小修繕感到更有信心，不需要打電話找人。

sentences.en: The documentary series I've been watching every night this week has completely changed the way I think about food production and sustainable living.
sentences.zh: 這週我每晚看的紀錄片系列完全改變了我對食品生產和永續生活的看法。

sentences.en: I never realized how much energy a deep cleaning of the entire apartment requires until I tried to do it all by myself in a single afternoon.
sentences.zh: 我從來沒意識到徹底打掃整個公寓需要多少精力，直到我試著在一個下午獨自完成它。

sentences.en: What makes my home feel truly comfortable is not the expensive furniture, but rather the personal touches like family photos and handmade decorations.
sentences.zh: 讓我的家真正感覺舒適的不是昂貴的家具，而是像家庭照片和手工裝飾品這樣的個人風格。
